about_short_description.short_description: Jam.gg is a cloud gaming platform.

product.name: Cloud Gaming Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables developers to publish, customize, and monetize games accessible via instant cloud play.

product.name: Meterage Billing System
product.description: A billing model that charges developers based on actual usage or consumption of cloud gaming resources.

product.name: Essential Plan
product.description: A package offering core features for seamless game publishing, including build uploads, pricing customization, usage-based revenue, instant cloud play, and free trial options.

product.name: Enterprise Plan
product.description: An advanced service tier for industry leaders that includes all Essential Plan features plus video on demand, chat, beta testing, dedicated support, and collaborative customization.
